subject: Unusual duplicate meter lines in April invoice — evidence request & provisional credit
messages:
From: Mark Tomas <mark.tomas@acme-pay.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: billing@acme-pay.com
Date: Thu, 30 May 2029 09:14:00 -0400
Subject: April marketplace invoice — duplicate meter lines / payout hold

Hi Jonas / Marissa,

We pulled the April marketplace invoice for our EU seller IDs and flagged ~€38,450 in duplicate metering lines that appear under two different listing SKUs (listing-A vs listing-A-migrated). Finance is pausing the April payout until we get a verified usage reconciliation.

We need the following from Redwood to release the hold:
- Per-tenant usage CSV for the affected period (UTC timestamps, usage_id, listing_sku, customer_tenant_id).
- Trace that maps your marketplace usage IDs to the seller invoice lines you generated (seller_invoice_id + ledger reference).
- A proposed credit memo and confirmation of how VAT will be handled (Acme is VAT-registered in IE; our AP needs to know whether to treat credit as net against VAT or as tax-adjusted).

Can you confirm receipt and share an ETA? Our collections team needs this by EOD Tue (2029-06-04) to avoid longer withholding.

Thanks,
Mark Tomas
Head of Billing Operations
Acme Payments

Attachment: april_duplicate_meter_delta.csv (CSV extract of lines we flagged)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Mark Tomas <mark.tomas@acme-pay.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 30 May 2029 11:03:22 -0400
Subject: Re: April marketplace invoice — duplicate meter lines / payout hold

Mark — thanks for the heads up. We received your CSV and triaged with infra and accounting. High-level: looks like a migration duplicate: a short window where the old listing and the new listing both emitted usage_id records for the same sessions.

Proposed immediate plan (10 business day track):
1) Data extraction (2 business days): we will produce a tenant-level delta CSV that includes usage_id, timestamp_utc, listing_sku, seller_invoice_id, and delta_flag (duplicate/original).
2) Technical reconciliation (3 business days): match transactions to your supplied seller invoice lines and provide mapping rows with ledger refs.
3) Accounting & tax treatment (3 business days): draft provisional credit memo that includes VAT treatment options (net vs tax-adjusted) and route to TaxOps if required.
4) Final credit & payout release (2 business days after mutual sign-off): apply credit or offset and confirm settlement.

To keep your payout pipeline moving, we can issue a provisional credit equal to the disputed net usage amount while we finish the full mapping — we will show VAT as a separate line and propose a gross credit plus a VAT reclassification if necessary. To issue the provisional credit we need: (A) written confirmation from Acme AP that provisional credit is acceptable, and (B) the seller invoice IDs you intend to apply it against.

I attached a short checklist of evidence we typically need — will follow up with the raw extract and our draft credit memo by EOD Mon (2029-06-03). If you prefer a quick sync, I can open a 30-min slot tomorrow.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Head of Marketplace Finance — Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: requested-evidence-checklist.pdf
